_comment: Static error code text overrides / additions for the ur_client_library.
This file is merged with the upstream UR ErrorCodes JSON by
Entries in this file take precedence over the upstream JSON on collision.
Format: same as the UR ErrorCodes JSON — each entry must have 'code' and
'text'; 'arg' is optional (omit for a code-only / wildcard entry).
NOTE: For error codes whose text must be computed dynamically at runtime
(e.g. C100 where the robot mode name is derived from the argument value),
add a case to src/ur/error_code_overrides.cpp instead.
